signature.name: VTask.toOpposite
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_3} -> {B : Type u_4} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Algebra R B] -> (f : A →ₐ[R] B) -> (hf : ∀ (x y : A), Commute (f x) (f y)) -> A →ₐ[R] Bᵐᵒᵖ

conventions.statement: The underlying function of VTask.toOpposite f hf is op ∘ f, where op : B → Bᵐᵒᵖ is the canonical map into the opposite type.
conventions.note: This is the standard choice; no alternative data is introduced.

facts.statement: ∀ (R A B : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (hf : ∀ x y : A, Commute (f x) (f y)) (r : R), (VTask.toOpposite f hf) (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap R Bᵐᵒᵖ r
